finding.text: At 400 a row's meta line runs past the right edge and is cut off: "claude-s…" and the State cell are lost on the monorepo row, and the prompt preview stops mid-word with no ellipsis (layout 26, wrapping 23) — shots/…sessions/400.png, rows band (y≈840–870). layout.json reports overflow_x false, so the box clips rather than scrolls; the meta line should wrap (it is a control-style row) or drop the model to its own line.

The headers are now all sort toggles, but nothing shows it until one is clicked: plain text, no arrow or hover cue at rest (page 8) — shots/…/1200.png, header row. A faint ↕ on hover, or the default-order arrow on Cost, would make it self-evident.

`State` sorts "biggest first", so the first click puts idle sessions (1) above working ones (0) — the reverse of what a reader wants first (page.js `SORT_VALUE.state` + `natural_dir`). Make `state` start ascending.

`Session.read_text` in node now calls `Session.locate`, so a READ can rename a flat folder into its day folder, and an unknown id gets today's day cached. A read with a move side effect is surprising; doc/layout.md mentions it only for writers.

The diff deletes ~140 tracked `sessions/<id>/files.jsonl` listings and `session-place.mjs` `rmSync`s them. They are server-generated and now gitignored, so nothing is lost, but "Never destructive" asks that the landing report say so.

At 3440 the Name column takes ~60% of the grid while Updated / Duration / Role sit in ~70px tracks (shots/…/3440.png, rows band; layout.json empty 0.75 at 3440). Not wrong, but a Name ceiling would let the numbers breathe.
Previous round's fix (empty shots, no index) is resolved: every width now shows 603 sessions and priced rows.
